"""HarnessProtocol implementation driving __DISPLAY__ as an Agent Client Protocol agent.

The CLI runs as one long-lived ACP agent over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0).  A
harness cycle is ``initialize`` plus one ``session/new`` (or
``session/load`` when resuming); each external Turn is one
``session/prompt`` whose ``session/update`` notifications become protocol
events and whose response carries the stop reason.  Abort is ACP's
``session/cancel``; tool permission requests become host tool approvals.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import contextlib
import os
import uuid
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping

from openjiuwen.harness_protocol import (
    PROTOCOL_VERSION,
    AbortMode,
    CheckpointReason,
    HarnessCapability,
    HarnessCard,
    HarnessContext,
    HarnessProtocolError,
    HostCapability,
    JsonObject,
    McpTransport,
    ModelOption,
    ModelRequestEvent,
    ModelRequestStatus,
    ModelSelection,
    ResumePolicy,
    ToolApprovalDecision,
    ToolApprovalRequest,
    TurnEventKind,
    TurnResult,
    UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError,
)
from openjiuwen.harness_providers.base import (
    PendingTurn,
    ProviderStartupError,
    SerializedTurnHarness,
    TurnTiming,
    logger,
)
from openjiuwen.harness_providers.inputs import harness_input_text
from openjiuwen.harness_providers.jsonsafe import to_json_object, to_json_safe
from openjiuwen.harness_providers.mcp_naming import TOOL_PLACEHOLDER, mcp_tool_naming_preamble
from openjiuwen.harness_providers.skills import install_skills
from __PKG__.bundled import select_executable
from __PKG__.config import __CLASS__HarnessConfig, __CLASS__ModelConfig
from __PKG__.failure_classifier import classify_exception, turn_error
from __PKG__.mapping import PROVIDER_NAME, MappedEvent, __CLASS__TurnAccumulator
from __PKG__.process import CliLaunch, CliProcess
from __PKG__.rpc import JsonRpcConnection, JsonRpcConnectionClosed, MethodNotFound

ADAPTER_VERSION = "0.1.0"
ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION = 1
# SCAFFOLD(skills-dir): the project-relative directory this CLI discovers
# skills in (e.g. ".opencode/skills"); ``None`` when it has none, in which
# case configured skills are rejected instead of silently ignored.
SKILLS_SCAN_DIR: str | None = None
# SCAFFOLD(model): how this CLI selects a model. Try both on the real CLI and
# keep what works, agents differ: opencode 1.17 answers
# ``session/set_config_option`` with "model not found" even for the values it
# lists, while Kimi Code 2.1.1 rejects a launch flag but switches through it.
# MODEL_ARGS is the launch flag with ``{model}`` where the name goes, e.g.
# ("--model", "{model}"). MODEL_CONFIG_ID is the ``id`` of the model selector
# in ``session/new``'s ``configOptions`` (e.g. "model"); the session is then
# switched and the reported ``currentValue`` checked. With neither, a
# configured model is rejected at start.
MODEL_ARGS: tuple[str, ...] = ()
MODEL_CONFIG_ID: str | None = None
# SCAFFOLD(mcp-naming): how this CLI names an MCP server's tools to the model,
# with ``{server}`` and ``{tool}``, e.g. "mcp__{server}__{tool}". Read it from
# the ``title`` of a real ``tool_call`` for a tool of a mounted server; keep
# ``None`` only if the CLI shows the bare tool name.
MCP_TOOL_NAME_PATTERN: str | None = None
# SCAFFOLD(endpoint): how this CLI runs a model on a host endpoint instead of
# its own login: a function returning the child environment that makes the
# endpoint model the session default (e.g. a config-content variable, or
# vendor ``*_BASE_URL`` / ``*_API_KEY`` / ``*_MODEL`` variables). It enables
# ENDPOINT_MODELS and, with ``loadSession``, AUTH_FALLBACK: the fallback
# restarts the agent with the fallback endpoint and loads the same session.
# Keep ``None`` when the CLI cannot be pointed at an endpoint.
ENDPOINT_ENV: Callable[[__CLASS__ModelConfig], dict[str, str]] | None = None
# ACP has no system prompt field; the host prompt rides on the first prompt
# of a fresh session, fenced so it reads as instructions, not as the request.
_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FENCE = "<system-instructions>\n{prompt}\n</system-instructions>\n\n"
_ALLOW_KINDS = ("allow_once", "allow_always")
_ALLOW_SESSION_KINDS = ("allow_always", "allow_once")
_REJECT_KINDS = ("reject_once", "reject_always")
# A per-session model selector is also a live one: the same
# ``session/set_config_option`` switches the model between turns, and the
# selector's ``options`` list what the agent offers.
_MODEL_CAPABILITIES = (
    frozenset({HarnessCapability.MODEL_DISCOVERY, HarnessCapability.MODEL_SELECTION})
    if MODEL_CONFIG_ID is not None
    else frozenset()
)
_ENDPOINT_CAPABILITIES = frozenset({HarnessCapability.ENDPOINT_MODELS}) if ENDPOINT_ENV is not None else frozenset()
_AUTH_FALLBACK_NEEDS = frozenset({HarnessCapability.ENDPOINT_MODELS, HarnessCapability.PERSISTENT_SESSION})


def _with_auth_fallback(capabilities: frozenset[HarnessCapability]) -> frozenset[HarnessCapability]:
    """Add AUTH_FALLBACK when the agent takes endpoints and loads sessions.

    The fallback restarts the agent on the fallback endpoint and loads the live
    session into it, so it needs ENDPOINT_MODELS and PERSISTENT_SESSION
    (``loadSession``); without either it could never activate.
    """
    if _AUTH_FALLBACK_NEEDS <= capabilities:
        return capabilities | {HarnessCapability.AUTH_FALLBACK}
    return capabilities


class __CLASS__Harness(SerializedTurnHarness):
    """Adapt one __DISPLAY__ ACP agent process and one ACP session to protocol v1."""

    card = HarnessCard(
        name=PROVIDER_NAME,
        implementation_version=ADAPTER_VERSION,
        protocol_version=PROTOCOL_VERSION,
        compatible_protocol_versions=frozenset({PROTOCOL_VERSION}),
        # SCAFFOLD(capabilities): GRACEFUL_ABORT is ``session/cancel`` and
        # MCP_TOOLS is ``session/new``'s ``mcpServers``; both are mandatory ACP.
        # PERSISTENT_SESSION and CHECKPOINT need ``agentCapabilities.loadSession``.
        # Keep exactly what the e2e suite proved against the real CLI.
        capabilities=_with_auth_fallback(
            frozenset(
                {
                    HarnessCapability.GRACEFUL_ABORT,
                    HarnessCapability.MCP_TOOLS,
                    HarnessCapability.PERSISTENT_SESSION,
                    HarnessCapability.CHECKPOINT,
                }
            )
            | _MODEL_CAPABILITIES
            | _ENDPOINT_CAPABILITIES
        ),
        optional_host_capabilities=frozenset(
            {
                HostCapability.TOOL_APPROVAL,
                HostCapability.MCP_SERVERS,
                HostCapability.CHECKPOINT_SINK,
                HostCapability.MODEL_REQUEST_OBSERVATION,
            }
        ),
    )

    def __init__(self, config: __CLASS__HarnessConfig | None = None) -> None:
        """Bind the provider configuration; the CLI starts on ``start``.

        Args:
            config: Provider-owned options; defaults launch ``__BINARY__``.
        """
        self._config = config or __CLASS__HarnessConfig()
        super().__init__(event_buffer_capacity=self._config.event_buffer_capacity)
        self._process: CliProcess | None = None
        self._rpc: JsonRpcConnection | None = None
        self._agent_capabilities: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._acp_session_id: str | None = None
        # The live session's ``configOptions`` as last reported by the agent.
        self._config_options: Any = None
        self._accumulator: __CLASS__TurnAccumulator | None = None
        # The endpoint model the agent process was launched on; ``None`` runs
        # on the CLI's own login. The auth fallback moves it to the fallback.
        self._active_endpoint: __CLASS__ModelConfig | None = self._config.endpoint_model
        # The CLI-login model the session runs on, runtime selections included;
        # a restart on the primary restores it rather than the configured one.
        self._primary_model: str | None = self._config.model
        # A restart left no agent behind; the next turn reloads the session.
        self._restore_pending = False
        self._cwd: str | None = None
        self._prelude = ""

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Provider hooks
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _validate_context(self, context: HarnessContext) -> None:
        super()._validate_context(context)
        resumes = context.resume_policy is ResumePolicy.REQUIRE_RESUME or context.checkpoint is not None
        if resumes and not self.card.supports(HarnessCapability.CHECKPOINT):
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("__DISPLAY__ cannot restore protocol checkpoints")
        if context.mcp_servers and not self.card.supports(HarnessCapability.MCP_TOOLS):
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("__DISPLAY__ cannot mount host MCP servers")
        if any(server.transport is McpTransport.IN_PROCESS for server in context.mcp_servers):
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("an ACP agent cannot mount in-process MCP servers")
        if context.system_prompt and self._config.system_prompt_delivery == "none":
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("system_prompt_delivery='none' cannot carry a system prompt")
        if self._config.skills and SKILLS_SCAN_DIR is None:
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("__DISPLAY__ has no skill discovery directory for portable skills")
        uses_endpoint = self._config.endpoint_model is not None or self._config.fallback_model is not None
        if uses_endpoint and ENDPOINT_ENV is None:
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("__DISPLAY__ cannot run a model on a host endpoint")
        if self._config.model is not None and not MODEL_ARGS and MODEL_CONFIG_ID is None:
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("__DISPLAY__ cannot select a model")

    async def _open_session(self, context: HarnessContext) -> str | None:
        cwd = os.path.abspath(context.cwd or self._config.cwd or os.getcwd())
        if self._config.skills:
            await asyncio.to_thread(
                install_skills,
                self._config.skills,
                provider=PROVIDER_NAME,
                cwd=cwd,
                conflict=self._config.skill_conflict,
                scan_dir=SKILLS_SCAN_DIR,
            )
        self._cwd = cwd
        self._active_endpoint = self._config.endpoint_model
        self._primary_model = self._config.model
        self._restore_pending = False
        try:
            rpc = await self._start_agent(context, cwd)
            session_id, resumed, config_options = await self._open_acp_session(rpc, context, cwd)
            config_options = await self._select_model(rpc, session_id, config_options)
        except (asyncio.CancelledError, ProviderStartupError, HarnessProtocolError, UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError):
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            error = classify_exception(exc)
            raise ProviderStartupError(f"__DISPLAY__ startup failed: {type(exc).__name__}", error=error) from exc
        self._acp_session_id = session_id
        self._config_options = config_options
        self._prelude = "" if resumed else self._system_prelude(context)
        if self.card.supports(HarnessCapability.CHECKPOINT):
            await self._publish_checkpoint(
                {"session_id": session_id, "resumed": resumed},
                reason=CheckpointReason.SESSION_ACTIVATED,
            )
        return session_id

    async def _start_agent(self, context: HarnessContext, cwd: str) -> JsonRpcConnection:
        """Launch the agent process on the active model and complete ``initialize``."""
        process = CliProcess(max_line_bytes=self._config.max_line_bytes)
        self._process = process
        argv, env = self._launch(context)
        await process.start(CliLaunch(argv=argv, env=env, cwd=cwd))
        rpc = JsonRpcConnection(process, on_notification=self._on_notification, on_request=self._on_request)
        self._rpc = rpc
        rpc.start()
        await self._initialize(rpc)
        return rpc

    async def _close_session(self) -> None:
        process, rpc = self._process, self._rpc
        self._process = None
        self._rpc = None
        self._accumulator = None
        self._acp_session_id = None
        self._config_options = None
        # Shut the child down first so the reader keeps draining stdout until
        # EOF; cancelling the reader first could leave the child blocked on a
        # full pipe until the terminate deadline.
        if process is not None:
            await process.shutdown(self._config.shutdown_timeout_s)
        if rpc is not None:
            await rpc.close()

    async def _execute_turn(self, turn: PendingTurn) -> tuple[TurnEventKind, TurnResult]:
        timing = TurnTiming()
        context = self._context
        observed = context is not None and HostCapability.MODEL_REQUEST_OBSERVATION in context.host_capabilities
        accumulator = __CLASS__TurnAccumulator(
            turn_id=turn.turn_id,
            observe_requests=observed,
            model=self._session_model(),
        )
        if turn.abort_requested:
            return TurnEventKind.ABORTED, accumulator.build_interrupted_result(turn, timing=timing)
        if self._restore_pending:
            try:
                await self._restore_session()
            except Exception as exc:
                return TurnEventKind.FAILED, accumulator.build_failed_result(classify_exception(exc), timing=timing)
        rpc = self._rpc
        if rpc is None or rpc.closed:
            exit_code = self._process.returncode if self._process is not None else None
            error = classify_exception(JsonRpcConnectionClosed(exit_code))
            return TurnEventKind.FAILED, accumulator.build_failed_result(error, timing=timing)
        text = self._prelude + harness_input_text(turn.content)
        self._accumulator = accumulator
        try:
            future = rpc.send_request(
                "session/prompt",
                {"sessionId": self._acp_session_id, "prompt": [{"type": "text", "text": text}]},
            )
            try:
                response = await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(future), self._config.turn_timeout_s)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                return TurnEventKind.FAILED, await self._time_out(turn, accumulator, future, timing)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            status = ModelRequestStatus.CANCELLED if turn.abort_requested else ModelRequestStatus.FAILED
            await self._emit_mapped(turn, accumulator.finish(status))
            if turn.abort_requested:
                return TurnEventKind.ABORTED, accumulator.build_interrupted_result(turn, timing=timing)
            return TurnEventKind.FAILED, accumulator.build_failed_result(classify_exception(exc), timing=timing)
        finally:
            self._accumulator = None
        # The agent answered, so it has seen the prelude: never send it twice.
        self._prelude = ""
        await self._emit_mapped(turn, [*accumulator.finish(), *accumulator.usage_event(response)])
        return accumulator.build_terminal_result(response, turn=turn, timing=timing)

    async def _interrupt_turn(self, turn: PendingTurn, mode: AbortMode) -> None:
        _ = turn, mode
        await self._cancel_prompt()

    async def _list_models(self) -> tuple[ModelOption, ...]:
        config_options = self._config_options
        if config_options is None:
            config_options = await self._probe_config_options()
        selector = _model_option(config_options)
        current = selector.get("currentValue")
        return tuple(
            ModelOption(
                model_id=value,
                display_name=str(entry.get("name") or value),
                description=str(entry.get("description") or ""),
                is_default=value == current,
            )
            for entry, value in _offered_entries(selector)
        )

    async def _apply_model_selection(self, selection: ModelSelection) -> None:
        if selection.effort is not None:
            raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError("__DISPLAY__ has no reasoning effort selector")
        if selection.model is None:
            return
        rpc, session_id = self._rpc, self._acp_session_id
        if rpc is None or rpc.closed or session_id is None:
            raise HarnessProtocolError("__DISPLAY__ has no live session to switch the model of")
        try:
            self._config_options = await self._switch_model(rpc, session_id, self._config_options, selection.model)
        except ProviderStartupError as exc:
            raise HarnessProtocolError(exc.error.message) from exc
        if self._active_endpoint is None:
            self._primary_model = selection.model

    async def _probe_config_options(self) -> Any:
        """Read the session ``configOptions`` from a throwaway agent; prompts nothing."""
        cwd = os.path.abspath(self._config.cwd or os.getcwd())
        env: dict[str, str] = dict(os.environ) if self._config.inherit_process_env else {}
        env.update(self._config.env)
        executable = select_executable(self._config.cli_path, self._config.command[0], env)
        process = CliProcess(max_line_bytes=self._config.max_line_bytes)
        argv = (executable, *self._config.command[1:], *self._config.extra_args)
        await process.start(CliLaunch(argv=argv, env=env, cwd=cwd))
        rpc = JsonRpcConnection(process, on_notification=_ignore_notification, on_request=_refuse_request)
        rpc.start()
        try:
            await self._initialize(rpc)
            created = await rpc.request(
                "session/new",
                {"cwd": cwd, "mcpServers": []},
                timeout_s=self._config.initialize_timeout_s,
            )
            return created.get("configOptions")
        finally:
            await process.shutdown(self._config.shutdown_timeout_s)
            await rpc.close()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # ACP session setup
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def _initialize(self, rpc: JsonRpcConnection) -> None:
        result = await rpc.request(
            "initialize",
            {
                "protocolVersion": ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
                # The agent keeps its own file and terminal tools: the client
                # serves neither, so every tool call stays observable as the
                # agent's own item.
                "clientCapabilities": {"fs": {"readTextFile": False, "writeTextFile": False}, "terminal": False},
                "clientInfo": {"name": "openjiuwen", "version": ADAPTER_VERSION},
            },
            timeout_s=self._config.initialize_timeout_s,
        )
        version = result.get("protocolVersion")
        if version != ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION:
            error = turn_error(
                f"__DISPLAY__ speaks ACP version {version!r}, expected {ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION}",
                category="sdk_error",
                code="__UPPER___ACP_VERSION",
            )
            raise ProviderStartupError("__DISPLAY__ ACP version mismatch", error=error)
        capabilities = result.get("agentCapabilities")
        self._agent_capabilities = dict(capabilities) if isinstance(capabilities, Mapping) else {}

    async def _open_acp_session(
        self,
        rpc: JsonRpcConnection,
        context: HarnessContext,
        cwd: str,
    ) -> tuple[str, bool, Any]:
        """Load the checkpointed session when asked and possible, else create one.

        Returns:
            The ACP session id, whether it was resumed, and the session's
            ``configOptions`` as the agent reported them.
        """
        mcp_servers = self._acp_mcp_servers(context)
        restored = self._restored_checkpoint_data(context)
        restored_id = restored.get("session_id") if restored else None
        if not isinstance(restored_id, str) or not restored_id:
            restored_id = None
        policy = context.resume_policy
        if policy is ResumePolicy.REQUIRE_RESUME and restored_id is None:
            raise HarnessProtocolError("__DISPLAY__ checkpoint does not carry a session id to resume")
        if restored_id is not None and policy is not ResumePolicy.NEW:
            if self._agent_capabilities.get("loadSession") is True:
                # The agent replays the history as session/update notifications
                # before it answers; no turn is active, so they are not events.
                loaded = await rpc.request(
                    "session/load",
                    {"sessionId": restored_id, "cwd": cwd, "mcpServers": mcp_servers},
                    timeout_s=self._config.initialize_timeout_s,
                )
                return restored_id, True, loaded.get("configOptions")
            if policy is ResumePolicy.REQUIRE_RESUME:
                error = turn_error(
                    "__DISPLAY__ does not advertise loadSession",
                    category="sdk_error",
                    code="__UPPER___LOAD_UNSUPPORTED",
                )
                raise ProviderStartupError("__DISPLAY__ cannot resume a session", error=error)
        created = await rpc.request(
            "session/new",
            {"cwd": cwd, "mcpServers": mcp_servers},
            timeout_s=self._config.initialize_timeout_s,
        )
        session_id = created.get("sessionId")
        if not isinstance(session_id, str) or not session_id:
            raise HarnessProtocolError("__DISPLAY__ session/new returned no sessionId")
        return session_id, False, created.get("configOptions")

    async def _select_model(self, rpc: JsonRpcConnection, session_id: str, config_options: Any) -> Any:
        """Switch the session to the configured model and confirm the switch.

        Only for agents selecting the model per session (``MODEL_CONFIG_ID``);
        a launch flag already applied it.

        Returns:
            The session ``configOptions`` after the switch.

        Raises:
            ProviderStartupError: When the session does not offer the model or
                the agent did not apply it.
        """
        model = self._primary_model
        if model is None or MODEL_CONFIG_ID is None or self._active_endpoint is not None:
            return config_options
        return await self._switch_model(rpc, session_id, config_options, model)

    async def _switch_model(self, rpc: JsonRpcConnection, session_id: str, config_options: Any, model: str) -> Any:
        """Set the session model through its selector and check the agent applied it.

        Returns:
            The session ``configOptions`` the agent reported after the switch.

        Raises:
            ProviderStartupError: When the session does not offer the model or
                the agent kept another one.
        """
        offered = _offered_models(_model_option(config_options))
        if model not in offered:
            error = turn_error(
                f"__DISPLAY__ does not offer model {model!r}",
                category="request_rejected",
                code="__UPPER___UNKNOWN_MODEL",
                provider_data={"offered": offered},
            )
            raise ProviderStartupError("__DISPLAY__ model is not available", error=error)
        result = await rpc.request(
            "session/set_config_option",
            {"sessionId": session_id, "configId": MODEL_CONFIG_ID, "value": model},
            timeout_s=self._config.initialize_timeout_s,
        )
        updated = result.get("configOptions")
        current = _model_option(updated).get("currentValue")
        if current != model:
            error = turn_error(
                f"__DISPLAY__ kept model {current!r} instead of {model!r}",
                category="sdk_error",
                code="__UPPER___MODEL_NOT_APPLIED",
            )
            raise ProviderStartupError("__DISPLAY__ did not switch the model", error=error)
        return updated

    def _acp_mcp_servers(self, context: HarnessContext) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        mcp_capabilities = self._agent_capabilities.get("mcpCapabilities")
        http_supported = isinstance(mcp_capabilities, Mapping) and mcp_capabilities.get("http") is True
        servers: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for server in context.mcp_servers:
            if server.transport is McpTransport.STDIO:
                servers.append(
                    {
                        "name": server.name,
                        "command": server.command[0],
                        "args": list(server.command[1:]),
                        "env": [{"name": key, "value": value} for key, value in server.env.items()],
                    }
                )
            elif server.transport is McpTransport.HTTP and http_supported:
                servers.append(
                    {
                        "type": "http",
                        "name": server.name,
                        "url": server.url,
                        "headers": [{"name": key, "value": value} for key, value in server.headers.items()],
                    }
                )
            else:
                raise UnsupportedHarnessCapabilityError(
                    f"__DISPLAY__ cannot mount MCP server {server.name!r} over {server.transport.value}"
                )
        return servers

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Agent -> client traffic
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Authentication fallback
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _auth_fallback_payload(self) -> JsonObject | None:
        fallback = self._config.fallback_model
        if fallback is None or ENDPOINT_ENV is None:
            return None
        return {"model": fallback.model, "api_base": fallback.api_base}

    async def _reconnect_for_auth(self, *, fallback: bool) -> None:
        """Restart the agent on the fallback (or primary) model and load the same session."""
        context, session_id, cwd = self._context, self._acp_session_id, self._cwd
        if context is None or session_id is None or cwd is None:
            raise HarnessProtocolError("__DISPLAY__ has no live session to move to another model")
        if self._agent_capabilities.get("loadSession") is not True:
            raise HarnessProtocolError("__DISPLAY__ cannot resume its session on another model")
        await self._close_session()
        # Keep the session id across a failed restart: the next attempt (the
        # primary model after a declined switch, or the next turn) loads it.
        self._acp_session_id = session_id
        self._active_endpoint = self._config.fallback_model if fallback else self._config.endpoint_model
        try:
            await self._restore_session()
        except BaseException:
            # The host never ratified a fallback whose restart failed: the
            # next turn restores the primary model, not the fallback.
            self._active_endpoint = self._config.endpoint_model
            raise

    async def _restore_session(self) -> None:
        """Start the agent on the active model and load the live session into it.

        A failure leaves no half-started agent behind and marks the session
        for the next turn, which tries again once the cause is gone.
        """
        context, session_id, cwd = self._context, self._acp_session_id, self._cwd
        if context is None or session_id is None or cwd is None:
            raise HarnessProtocolError("__DISPLAY__ has no session to restore")
        self._restore_pending = True
        try:
            rpc = await self._start_agent(context, cwd)
            loaded = await rpc.request(
                "session/load",
                {"sessionId": session_id, "cwd": cwd, "mcpServers": self._acp_mcp_servers(context)},
                timeout_s=self._config.initialize_timeout_s,
            )
            self._config_options = await self._select_model(rpc, session_id, loaded.get("configOptions"))
        except BaseException:
            await self._close_session()
            self._acp_session_id = session_id
            raise
        self._restore_pending = False

    async def _on_notification(self, method: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        if method != "session/update" or params.get("sessionId") != self._acp_session_id:
            return
        accumulator = self._accumulator
        turn = self.active_turn
        update = params.get("update")
        # Outside a turn the agent is replaying a loaded session (or chatting
        # between prompts, e.g. command lists); neither is a turn event.
        if accumulator is None or turn is None or not isinstance(update, Mapping):
            return
        await self._emit_mapped(turn, accumulator.consume(update))

    async def _on_request(self, method: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if method == "session/request_permission":
            return await self._answer_permission(params)
        raise MethodNotFound(method)

    async def _answer_permission(self, params: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Answer ``session/request_permission`` from the host or the auto-approve default."""
        raw_options = params.get("options")
        options = [option for option in raw_options if isinstance(option, Mapping)] if isinstance(raw_options, list) else []
        turn = self.active_turn
        if turn is None or turn.abort_requested:
            return {"outcome": {"outcome": "cancelled"}}
        decision = await self._permission_decision(turn, params, options)
        if turn.abort_requested:
            return {"outcome": {"outcome": "cancelled"}}
        option_id = _pick_option(options, decision)
        if option_id is None:
            return {"outcome": {"outcome": "cancelled"}}
        return {"outcome": {"outcome": "selected", "optionId": option_id}}

    async def _permission_decision(
        self,
        turn: PendingTurn,
        params: Mapping[str, Any],
        options: list[Mapping[str, Any]],
    ) -> ToolApprovalDecision:
        context = self._context
        routed = context is not None and HostCapability.TOOL_APPROVAL in context.host_capabilities
        if not routed or not self._has_host_interactions():
            return ToolApprovalDecision.ALLOW if self._config.auto_approve else ToolApprovalDecision.DENY
        tool_call = params.get("toolCall")
        call = tool_call if isinstance(tool_call, Mapping) else {}
        call_id = str(call.get("toolCallId") or uuid.uuid4().hex)
        request = ToolApprovalRequest(
            request_id=f"{PROVIDER_NAME}:permission:{call_id}:{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}",
            call_id=call_id,
            tool_name=str(call.get("title") or call.get("kind") or "tool"),
            arguments=to_json_object(call.get("rawInput") or {}),
            provider_session_id=self._session_id,
            turn_id=turn.turn_id,
            provider_data={"kind": to_json_safe(call.get("kind")), "options": to_json_safe(options)},
        )
        response = await self._request_interaction(request)
        decision = getattr(response, "decision", None)
        return decision if isinstance(decision, ToolApprovalDecision) else ToolApprovalDecision.DENY

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Helpers
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def _time_out(
        self,
        turn: PendingTurn,
        accumulator: __CLASS__TurnAccumulator,
        future: asyncio.Future[dict[str, Any]],
        timing: TurnTiming,
    ) -> TurnResult:
        """Cancel a prompt that outlived ``turn_timeout_s`` and wait briefly for its answer."""
        await self._cancel_prompt()
        # Let the cancelled prompt settle so its trailing updates stay in this turn.
        with contextlib.suppress(Exception):
            await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(future), self._config.shutdown_timeout_s)
        await self._emit_mapped(turn, accumulator.finish(ModelRequestStatus.CANCELLED))
        error = turn_error(
            f"__DISPLAY__ did not finish the turn within {self._config.turn_timeout_s:g}s",
            category="network_timeout",
            code="__UPPER___TURN_TIMEOUT",
        )
        return accumulator.build_failed_result(error, timing=timing)

    async def _cancel_prompt(self) -> None:
        rpc = self._rpc
        if rpc is None or self._acp_session_id is None:
            return
        try:
            await rpc.notify("session/cancel", {"sessionId": self._acp_session_id})
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning("[%s] session/cancel failed: %s", PROVIDER_NAME, type(exc).__name__)

    async def _emit_mapped(self, turn: PendingTurn, mapped: list[MappedEvent]) -> None:
        for event in mapped:
            payload = event.payload
            if isinstance(payload, ModelRequestEvent):
                payload = await self._observe_request(payload)
            await self._emit(payload, turn=turn, item_id=event.item_id, causation_ids=event.causation_ids)

    # Overridden per vendor; instance state (the session's record) lives there.
    # pylint: disable-next=add-staticmethod-or-classmethod-decorator
    async def _observe_request(self, request: ModelRequestEvent) -> ModelRequestEvent:
        """Complete a request derived from the ACP stream with the vendor's own record.

        SCAFFOLD(observation): the stream only shows what the model produced.
        When the CLI records its requests (Kimi Code's ``wire.jsonl``, a local
        database, request logs), find the record of this request and return
        the event with what it states: ``system_instructions``,
        ``input_messages`` (with stable message ids) and
        ``input_observed=True``, ``tool_definitions``, ``usage``, the served
        ``model``. Keep ``request_id``: tool items already cite it. Wait for a
        record briefly at most, and return ``request`` unchanged when none
        arrives. See ``references/observation.md``.
        """
        return request

    def _session_model(self) -> str | None:
        """Return the model the session runs on: the endpoint model, else the CLI-login one."""
        endpoint = self._active_endpoint
        return endpoint.model if endpoint is not None else self._primary_model

    def _launch(self, context: HarnessContext) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], dict[str, str]]:
        """Argv and environment of the agent process.

        The executable is ``cli_path`` when configured, else ``command[0]``
        found on ``PATH``, else the CLI bundled in this package (whose helper
        directory then goes first on ``PATH``).
        """
        env = self._child_env(context)
        executable = select_executable(self._config.cli_path, self._config.command[0], env)
        endpoint = self._active_endpoint
        if endpoint is not None and ENDPOINT_ENV is not None:
            env.update(ENDPOINT_ENV(endpoint))
        model = self._primary_model if endpoint is None else None
        model_args = tuple(arg.format(model=model) for arg in MODEL_ARGS) if model is not None else ()
        command = (executable, *self._config.command[1:])
        return (*command, *model_args, *self._config.extra_args), env

    def _child_env(self, context: HarnessContext) -> dict[str, str]:
        env: dict[str, str] = dict(os.environ) if self._config.inherit_process_env else {}
        env.update(self._config.env)
        env.update(context.env)
        return env

    def _system_prelude(self, context: HarnessContext) -> str:
        parts = [part for part in (_mcp_naming(context), context.system_prompt) if part]
        if not parts or self._config.system_prompt_delivery == "none":
            return ""
        return _SYSTEM_PROMPT_FENCE.format(prompt="\n\n".join(parts))


def _mcp_naming(context: HarnessContext) -> str:
    if MCP_TOOL_NAME_PATTERN is None or not context.mcp_servers:
        return ""
    patterns = {
        server.name: MCP_TOOL_NAME_PATTERN.format(server=server.name, tool=TOOL_PLACEHOLDER)
        for server in context.mcp_servers
    }
    return mcp_tool_naming_preamble(patterns)


def _pick_option(options: list[Mapping[str, Any]], decision: ToolApprovalDecision) -> str | None:
    """Return the ``optionId`` matching ``decision``, preferring the narrowest grant."""
    if decision is ToolApprovalDecision.ALLOW_FOR_SESSION:
        preferred = _ALLOW_SESSION_KINDS
    elif decision is ToolApprovalDecision.ALLOW:
        preferred = _ALLOW_KINDS
    else:
        preferred = _REJECT_KINDS
    for kind in preferred:
        for option in options:
            option_id = option.get("optionId")
            if option.get("kind") == kind and isinstance(option_id, str):
                return option_id
    return None


def _model_option(config_options: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    """Return the session's model selector from ACP ``configOptions``, or ``{}``."""
    if not isinstance(config_options, list):
        return {}
    for option in config_options:
        if isinstance(option, Mapping) and option.get("id") == MODEL_CONFIG_ID:
            return option
    return {}


def _offered_entries(option: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[tuple[Mapping[str, Any], str]]:
    """Return the selector's choices with their ``value``, skipping malformed ones."""
    values = option.get("options")
    if not isinstance(values, list):
        return []
    entries = [value for value in values if isinstance(value, Mapping)]
    return [(entry, entry["value"]) for entry in entries if isinstance(entry.get("value"), str)]


def _offered_models(option: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    return [value for _entry, value in _offered_entries(option)]


async def _ignore_notification(method: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    _ = method, params


async def _refuse_request(method: str, params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    _ = params
    raise MethodNotFound(method)


__all__ = ["ACP_PROTOCOL_VERSION", "ADAPTER_VERSION", "__CLASS__Harness"]
